# Sheikh Zayed Armour School

> The Armour School is a military training establishment inside a UAE Armed Forces cantonment, providing instruction for armoured corps personnel. Establishments of this type combine classrooms and lecture halls with technical training bays, vehicle workshops and hardstanding for armoured vehicles, alongside administration offices, stores and welfare facilities. The school forms one element of a wider garrison complex rather than standing as an isolated building.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Sharjah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

The Armour School is a military training facility at the Sheikh Zayed Military Cantonment, delivered with the Directorate of Military Works as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the school, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for the facility.
